cases.title: The Missing Husband
cases.description: Investigate the disappearance of Holly's husband and his connection to Mark Agency.

objectives.text: Find out what happened to Holly's husband.
Investigate his work at Mark Agency.

initialItems.label: The client: Holly
initialItems.text: Holly has asked you to find her missing husband.

initialItems.label: The missing husband
initialItems.text: Holly's husband worked at Mark Agency, recovering stolen artifacts. His whereabouts are unknown.

initialItems.label: The Mark Agency connection
initialItems.text: Investigate Mark Agency to find out what happened to him. A connection is a lead, not proof.

cases.title: Dead Men Calling
cases.description: Investigate three voicemail messages that appear to contain the voice of a deceased man.

objectives.text: Read the client’s email and obtain her contact details.
Review all three recent voicemail transcripts.
Complete the telephone interview with Margaret Vale.
Obtain Edward’s older recordings and compare them with the recent messages.
Establish who is calling and why they want the blue folder.

initialItems.label: Dead Men Calling
initialItems.text: A widow reports receiving messages in what sounds like her late husband’s voice. Read the client’s email before drawing conclusions.

initialItems.label: A voice is not an identity
initialItems.text: Are the recent messages genuine speech, reused recordings, an imitation or something else? The advertisement does not establish the answer.

cases.title: The Borrowed Alibi
cases.description: Find out why three strangers claim they had dinner with the advertiser.

objectives.text: Find a way to contact the advertiser at Box 17.
Identify the people using the client's alibi.
Establish what happened on Tuesday evening.

initialItems.label: Someone has been using my alibi
initialItems.text: The advertiser claims to have eaten alone on Tuesday. Three strangers reportedly say they were having dinner with the advertiser.

initialItems.label: Three strangers
initialItems.text: Their identities and reasons for using this alibi are unknown.
